ideas.pitch: An AI incident forecasting tool tailored for GNIT campus facilities using Poisson regression to predict maintenance failures and safety bottlenecks based on historical data.
ideas.title: GNIT Campus Incident & Safety Forecaster
ideas.why_it_could_win: Solves a problem the judges and campus administrators feel directly by addressing localized institutional safety and operational risks.

ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly targets the organizing body (ACM Chapter) by solving their exact pain points around event management and student outreach.
